intervention: Investigational proteasome-inhibitor targeted anticancer therapy; the public protocol does not name the study drug.
published_other_criteria: For a leukemia diagnosis, only chronic lymphocytic leukemia with confirmed B-cell lineage is within the published scope. The study team must confirm the B-cell lymphoid neoplasm by histopathology, cytology and PCR clonality; the animal must maintain normal daily activities, attend visits, and have no change to prior treatment during the week before study start.
funding: The official protocol does not publish a study-cost or subsidy breakdown. Confirm screening, study drug, monitoring, standard care and travel costs with the investigator before enrollment.

intervention: Alternating magnetic-field device treatment under anesthesia, approximately 30 minutes per session; typically twice weekly for three weeks. No heating medium or anticancer drug is used.
published_other_criteria: Small to medium-sized dogs with a malignant tumor of the head, mouth or neck. The study team must confirm device fit, tumor location and anesthesia suitability; the source gives no numeric weight cutoff.
